For 50 years, we’ve been perfecting the recipe for an exceptional international education. Watch our video to find out how we’ve brought the vision of our founder, Mary Crist Fleming, to life.
Join us for our Open Day on Saturday, October 10, 9:30 A.M. — 12:30 P.M, and experience firsthand our warm, welcoming, and globally minded school community. BOOK YOUR PLACE
We welcome families from all over the world on our beautiful 46-acre campus in Thorpe, Surrey.
TASIS England is a leading international day and boarding co-ed School near London for students aged 4-18. Our beautiful campus is ideally located on spacious grounds in the Surrey countryside.
From Pre-Kindergarten to Grade 12, our caring teachers are committed to providing a balance of academic challenge and support.
Our students come from all over the globe and go on to attend excellent universities in the United States, the UK, Canada, and worldwide.

pageCache.pageTitle: Career Counseling - TASIS England International American School near London
pageCache.text:
As a part of the TASIS College Counseling Program, our Grade 10 students take a personality and skills exam called the Morrisby Online Careers Assessment. Morrisby is a career counseling tool that helps students to identify potential career paths and make informed decisions about their study options. Participating students take a 100-minute online assessment and questionnaire that measures a variety of elements including career interests, work attitudes, talents, and motivations. Once the assessment is complete, students will have access to personally tailored career and education suggestions, plus a wealth of career-related resources.
After sitting for the assessment, each student receives:
Additionally, Grade 10 students receive a follow up session with college counselors to understand their results as well as being offered further one-to-one time to help interpret their results. We believe the Morrisby is an important tool in our kit to aid students in the post-secondary research and career counseling process, and are thrilled to have it as part of our college counseling programming.

pageCache.pageTitle: Career Speaker Series - TASIS England International American School near London
pageCache.text:
From start-ups to STEM, law to medicine, TASIS England Upper School students have the opportunity to learn from experts in different fields.
The Career Speaker Series is brought to you by the TASIS Parent Association (TPA), together with the TASIS College Counseling and Marketing departments.
Our speakers share what inspires them, how they found their passion, and the unfiltered realities of their profession. Students are encouraged to have a dialogue with our speakers and find out the "why" behind a variety of careers.
Our students and wider community help shape the series. By listening to their interests and ambitions, we curate a lineup that feels relevant, personal, and genuinely useful for the road ahead for our students.
Each year, our speakers are united by a central theme that connects diverse careers, industries, and life paths into a single, thought-provoking conversation. In 2026, that theme was Skills and Pathways for Global Futures, exploring how AI and a rapidly changing workplace are reshaping the way we work, and the paths that lead there.

pageCache.pageTitle: College Counseling Mission, Beliefs & Commitments - TASIS England International American School near London
pageCache.text:
College Counseling Mission, Beliefs & Commitments
As advocates for our students’ finding their best fit, we work in partnership with our community to affirm and support TASIS England’s mission, commitments and outcomes toward life-long learning. In doing so, we strive to embolden students to make choices that positively enhance their own well-being and that of others, now and for the future.
All students, with support and counseling, can take ownership of the post-secondary research to find the right fit and destination upon graduation from TASIS England based on their wants, needs, and abilities.
Students are able to speak openly and candidly with their counselor, understanding our work together is confidential.
Students are heard, acknowledged, and understood.
For College Counselors
A four-year college counseling program challenges students to explore options while also providing the skill set to complete and understand the post-secondary process.
An international college counseling program highlights the multitude of options available to students in different countries and contexts.
College Counselors work as a team to support one another and their students in the delivery of content and individual counseling across Grades 9-12.
The College Counselors, students, and families work collaboratively to support the post-secondary research and application process, preparing the student for their individual journey.
Our Commitments: We believe that this process is about self-discovery and growth, and we are excited to work with each student as they navigate their way along this momentous journey. Our guiding principle is much like that of a good teacher: meet the student where they are. The TASIS England post-secondary journey is guided by our commitment to:
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Connections
The College Counseling Office at TASIS England builds its program around the individual. We believe that the post-secondary process begins and ends with the student.
The College Counselors will provide students with tools and skills to reflect their beliefs and talents and help them choose the path that suits them best.
As a former student, Marine Corp Veteran, college graduate in biology and chemistry, I recommend TASIS to anyone looking to give their child the BEST education.

TASIS England students come from schools around the globe, and our graduates leave to attend the best-fit universities in the US, the UK, and worldwide. Our four-year University & College Counseling curriculum for our senior (Upper School) students provides them with individual support as they move forward with their education.
Why is college and university counseling for senior school students important?
In the University & College Counseling office, we are proud of the diversity of our students and that is reflected in the variety of our university list. As we work with and guide each student, we understand that there are many pathways toward their personal goals, whatever they may be. Our international college counseling program showcases the multitude of options available to our students. Whether they are an American student wanting to go to university in the UK, an international student looking to attend an American college, interested in moving abroad, or returning to their home country, we help each graduate achieve their dream. The Counseling team serves as a liaison between the students and universities. They provide guidance on choosing courses based on each student’s career goals, aspirations, and talents. The team also assists students in the management of the application process and financial aid details. No matter what path each TASIS England student takes in the future, they ultimately leave our School as compassionate, hard-working individuals with a passion for life-long learning.
At TASIS England, we know that every learner is unique. For our globally minded students, there is a seemingly infinite amount of post-secondary options available around the world.
We guide each student with tailored support and counseling so that they can research and find the right fit based on their passions, needs, and skills. The program is designed to provide them with the skills and tools to help them choose the best path toward further education and their careers. Our team is passionate about assisting students as they navigate their way through this journey of self-discovery and growth.
Beyond the national rankings that report the “best” universities is the reality that each person's collegiate experience is personal and unique. Finding the “best” university requires honest self-reflection, as it means something different for each student. Our college and career counseling program empowers our high school students by giving them the information and support they need to make the right decisions.
UNIVERSITY DESTINATIONS
University & College counseling support begins in the ninth grade with our four-year college counseling class, Future Pathways. Initially, we aim to help our students identify their unique personal, academic, artistic, leadership, and athletic qualities. As they begin to explore careers and university options, we guide students through the process of setting realistic goals and selecting suitable post-secondary options. Finally, we serve as a liaison between our senior students and universities - assisting with the application process, untangling any administrative “red tape,” and answering any questions that families may have.
Every learner’s journey is unique. We ensure each and every student is heard, acknowledged, and understood. Students are encouraged to speak openly and honestly with their University & College Counselor, with the understanding that the work they do together is confidential.
The Counseling team empowers each student to take ownership of the research process, gathering all available information so that they can find the right next step based on their individual passions, needs, and skills.
We host representatives from more that 75 universities every year, enabling students to meet those they are interested in, ask questions, and learn first-hand about what each offers. We have excellent links with universities around the world and share our many years of practical experience and knowledge with our students.
We work collaboratively with the students and their families to support the research and application process, providing each learner with expert guidance on their journey. We know each student has their own talents and interests, and we support them as they explore the path that is right for them.
Some students choose to engage with the Counseling team from the first day of freshman year and ask for their advice and input on a regular basis. Others may not be ready and choose a different option, such as a gap year. We will be here whenever they are ready.
The process of researching and applying for your child’s university place can feel daunting, and our University & College Counseling team is there for parents too. We share practical tips on how the application process works and partner with our families to ensure they’re supported through every step of the journey.
Universities offer a range of need- or merit-based options for support with funding undergraduate studies. We also offer information and resources in relation to scholarships and financial assistance.
Our many years of practical experience and strong links with universities worldwide enable us to offer knowledge and insight to help parents and students make a fully informed decision.
If you feel your child would benefit from the support and guidance offered to our students by our University & College Counseling team, please get in touch.
My counselor was very empathetic, patient, and understanding. I felt like they always listened to me and always had my best interest in mind.

pageCache.pageTitle: Board of Directors - TASIS England International American School near London
pageCache.text:
The TASIS the American School in England Board has the overall responsibility to set the fiscal and operating policies of the School.
The Board is responsible for creating a shared vision and strategic direction for the future. The Board also provides the oversight to maintain the standards and ethos under which it was founded, to adhere to the School's mission and to ensure the long-term financial viability of the School.
The TASIS Schools and Summer Programs are owned by the TASIS Foundation, a Swiss not-for-profit educational foundation registered in Delémont, Switzerland. TASIS England is registered in Thorpe, Surrey (Reg. No. 1604308) in the United Kingdom.
Mr. King graduated from the University of Southampton with a degree in Economics and Accountancy and then qualified as a chartered accountant. His career has included extensive experience in the accounting profession, specializing in audit and advisory work, and also in banking in a number of finance, compliance and audit roles. He has experience in the education sector, gained initially from twenty-five years' voluntary service as a Governor of a local primary school, twenty years as Chairman. He subsequently served as Bursar/CFO of TASIS England for eight and a half years, retiring at the end of September 2017 when he was appointed to the Board.
Mrs. Melissa Jones Briggs works as a lecturer in organisational behaviour at Stanford University’s Graduate School of Business and teaches in several of Stanford Executive Education programs on campus in California. Melissa also consults for leaders and teams at some of the world's top corporations and hyper-growth startups, NGOs and national institutions.
In the UK, Melissa serves as an Associate Fellow at the Oxford Character Project at the University of Oxford. She brings her experience as a TASIS England alumna (’00) and parent of two current students (’27, ’31) together with her work as an educator in the US and UK to serve as a Member of the Board.
Linda was elected to Runnymede Borough Council in 2000 and serves as an Independent representing residents in Thorpe Ward. Her main interests are in planning and governance both in Runnymede but also monitoring elections for the Council of Europe. Having served as a governor at two local schools for more than 30 years and as a director of the Thorpe Nursery Linda is also very familiar with primary education.
Mr. Gonzalez attended Phillips Academy Andover, Harvard College (BA in Visual Studies), and the Harvard Graduate School of Design. He started working at TASIS in 1972 as Chairman of the Art Department. Before becoming Administrative Director of the TASIS organization in 1997, Mr. Gonzalez was TASIS Director of Institutional Development for 20 years during a period of significant expansion for the TASIS organization. He served on the TASIS Executive Board for eight years and as Interim Headmaster of TASIS England from 2004-2005. In 2001, he co-founded TASIS Dorado, which is now a premier independent school in Puerto Rico. From September 2005 to 2008, Mr. Gonzalez served as Chairman of the newly formed Board of Directors of TASIS England. His love for creative design and restoring historic buildings has led him to architectural projects in France, England, Switzerland and Puerto Rico, as well as co-directing the Les Tapies Art & Architecture summer program in southern France. Mr. Gonzalez serves on the TASIS Foundation Board and has two sons and a stepdaughter who attended TASIS England. He now lives in Puerto Rico with his wife.
Mr. Karam, who is originally from Lebanon, is a TASIS England ’03 alumnus. He has lived in the UK since 2001 whereby, following completion of his high school studies at TASIS England, he went on to pursue three university degrees: B.Eng. in Computer Systems & Electronics at King’s College London, M.Sc. in Finance at Imperial College Business School, M.Sc. in Law and Accounting at London School of Economics and Political Science. Mr. Karam has relocated to the UAE on February 2025 and has been working with Blackstone since. Prior to this role, he worked at various financial institutions, most recently at Aperture Investors.
Mrs. Loveridge studied PPE at Oxford University and then worked in management consultancy and public relations. She is the founding principal of an independent pre-prep school for boys in London, and serves as a governor of an independent coed preparatory school in the country. Mrs. Loveridge has four now-grown-up children.
Mrs. McLaughlin has twin daughters who are TASIS England alumnae. An active member of the TASIS community, she served on the TASIS Parent Association for four years, including two years as president, and also served as a member of the board of the AWBS International Women's club. Mrs. McLaughlin earned a B.A. in Philosophy from Brown University and a J.D. from Boston University School of Law, and practiced commercial litigation in New York City and Philadelphia for several years. She lives locally with her husband Dennis and two children.
Mr. Wyper holds undergraduate and MBA degrees from the University of Virginia. He is a Senior Advisor of Hines, a global real estate practice, and provides an experienced resource on development management, master planning/land use/mixed-use projects, and new technology initiatives. Mr. Wyper and his wife lived in Europe from 1996 to 2012 (in England from 2001) and are now based in Atlanta, Georgia. Their daughter and son are both TASIS England alumni.
Cooperation between parents/guardians, teachers, administration, and our Board of Directors leads to a shared sense of purpose and a positive environment for learning and growing.
The Board Chairman, may be contacted via email at: chairman@tasisengland.org

pageCache.pageTitle: International Baccalaureate Diploma - TASIS England International American School near London
pageCache.text:
TASIS England offers the IB Diploma to eligible students entering Grade 11
The IB Diploma Programme is widely recognized and considered to be an international passport to higher education, as its strengths are based on the best practices of educational systems worldwide. It is a comprehensive two-year program that encourages critical thinking, research skills, and service as part of the learning process.
In 1968, the International Baccalaureate (IB) program first sought to create a diploma that would be “recognized by universities around the world,” according to the International Baccalaureate Organization (IBO). Candidates for the IB Diploma study a range of subjects and choose courses from six areas: English, a second language, individuals and societies, experimental sciences, mathematics and computer science, and the arts. In addition, students must submit an Extended Essay (a 4,000-word research project), complete a course on the philosophies of learning and knowing (Theory of Knowledge), and take part in community service. The IB Diploma Programme culminates in an examination period at the end of two years of study, and final grades are based on both achievement on the exams and course grades.TASIS is also a member of the IB Schools and Colleges Association (IBSCA).
The IB Diploma meets the requirement of many national educational systems and Ministries of Education, including Great Britain, the United States, Canada, and European countries. In fact, taking the IB Diploma often helps in the university admissions process, as it is a clear sign to admissions officials that a student is capable of following a rigorous course of study.
The IB Diploma Programme is a challenging two-year program. Entry into the IB Diploma Programme is made in consultation between TASIS England, the student, and the family, and is open to highly motivated students with strong academic, time management, and study skills. Prerequisites for entry to the program include a “B” average in previous and current courses of study, as well as specific requirements for particular IB courses. For non-native English speakers, the following English language levels are possible prerequisites: a CEFR score of C1 or above; TOEFL score of 550 (computer-based TOEFL score of 213); or a score of 79-80 on the Internet-based TOEFL. In some cases, where a student's math, language, or science background prevents participation in the program, TASIS England may recommend that the student enroll in a post-graduate year in order to complete the IB Diploma in Grades 11 and 12.
IB Diploma candidates must take a total of six IB courses, one from each of the groups below. For a full list of courses, please see IB Coursework.
Group 1: English (mandatory for all), German, and Spanish
Group 2: Second Language
Group 3: Individuals and Societies
Group 4: Experimental Sciences
Group 5: Mathematics and Computer Science
Of these courses, at least three, but no more than four, are taken at Higher Level (HL) and the others are taken at Standard Level (SL). Each course is taught over the two years of study. In addition to the six courses, IB Diploma candidates must meet the requirements for Theory of Knowledge (TOK), the Extended Essay, and Creativity, Action, and Service (CAS).

Whether they are an American student wanting to go to university in the UK, an international student looking to attend an American college, interested in moving abroad, or returning to their home country, we help each graduate achieve their dream. The Counseling team serves as a liaison between the students and universities. They provide guidance on choosing courses based on each student’s career goals, aspirations, and talents. The team also assists students in the management of the application process and financial aid details. No matter what path each TASIS England student takes in the future, they ultimately leave our School as compassionate, hard-working individuals with a passion for life-long learning.
At TASIS England, we know that every learner is unique. For our globally minded students, there is a seemingly infinite amount of post-secondary options available around the world.
We guide each student with tailored support and counseling so that they can research and find the right fit based on their passions, needs, and skills. The program is designed to provide them with the skills and tools to help them choose the best path toward further education and their careers. Our team is passionate about assisting students as they navigate their way through this journey of self-discovery and growth.
Beyond the national rankings that report the “best” universities is the reality that each person's collegiate experience is personal and unique. Finding the “best” university requires honest self-reflection, as it means something different for each student. Our college and career counseling program empowers our high school students by giving them the information and support they need to make the right decisions.
UNIVERSITY DESTINATIONS
University & College counseling support begins in the ninth grade with our four-year college counseling class, Future Pathways. Initially, we aim to help our students identify their unique personal, academic, artistic, leadership, and athletic qualities. As they begin to explore careers and university options, we guide students through the process of setting realistic goals and selecting suitable post-secondary options. Finally, we serve as a liaison between our senior students and universities - assisting with the application process, untangling any administrative “red tape,” and answering any questions that families may have.
Every learner’s journey is unique. We ensure each and every student is heard, acknowledged, and understood. Students are encouraged to speak openly and honestly with their University & College Counselor, with the understanding that the work they do together is confidential.
The Counseling team empowers each student to take ownership of the research process, gathering all available information so that they can find the right next step based on their individual passions, needs, and skills.
We host representatives from more that 75 universities every year, enabling students to meet those they are interested in, ask questions, and learn first-hand about what each offers. We have excellent links with universities around the world and share our many years of practical experience and knowledge with our students.
We work collaboratively with the students and their families to support the research and application process, providing each learner with expert guidance on their journey. We know each student has their own talents and interests, and we support them as they explore the path that is right for them.
Some students choose to engage with the Counseling team from the first day of freshman year and ask for their advice and input on a regular basis. Others may not be ready and choose a different option, such as a gap year. We will be here whenever they are ready.
The process of researching and applying for your child’s university place can feel daunting, and our University & College Counseling team is there for parents too. We share practical tips on how the application process works and partner with our families to ensure they’re supported through every step of the journey.
Universities offer a range of need- or merit-based options for support with funding undergraduate studies. We also offer information and resources in relation to scholarships and financial assistance.
Our many years of practical experience and strong links with universities worldwide enable us to offer knowledge and insight to help parents and students make a fully informed decision.
If you feel your child would benefit from the support and guidance offered to our students by our University & College Counseling team, please get in touch.

pageCache.pageTitle: Curriculum  - TASIS The American School in England, London, UK. IB School
pageCache.text:
The variety of TASIS England’s course offerings allow students to personalize their learning, choosing between the American high school diploma, with the potential for Advanced Placement Courses (AP), or the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme. Students are well-prepared and qualified for universities and colleges in the US, UK, and worldwide. Throughout Upper School, the core subjects (English, history, mathematics, science, and foreign languages) are complemented by the arts, humanities, and physical education. We prepare our students for the challenges and opportunities of the future by recognizing each individual's unique strengths, interests, and skills. For the final two years in the Upper School, students follow one of two pathways:
Both diplomas are widely accepted by universities and colleges around the world. Whichever curriculum they follow, our students are well prepared for a successful transition to further education.
Advanced Placement (AP) courses include Art History, Biology, Calculus AB, Calculus BC, Chemistry, Chinese Language and Culture, Comparative Government/US Government (alternating years), Computer Science A, Computer Science Principles, Cybersecurity, English Literature & Composition, English Language & Composition, Environmental Science, European History, French Language and Culture, Human Geography, Macro Economics, Micro Economics, Music Theory, Physics 1 & 2, Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism, Physics C: Mechanics, Psychology, Spanish Language and Culture, Statistics, US History. International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme courses include: Group 1: Language A Literature (HL/SL): English; Language A Language and Literature (HL/SL): English, German, Spanish; (SL) School-Supported Self-Taught Literature A Group 2: Language B (HL/SL): French, German, Spanish; Language Ab Initio (SL): French, Spanish Group 3: Individuals and Societies (HL/SL): Economics, Psychology; (HL) History Group 4: Sciences (HL/SL): Biology, Chemistry, Physics; (SL) Environmental Systems and Societies; Computer Science Group 5: Mathematics: (HL/SL) Analysis and Approaches (SL) Applications and Interpretation Group 6: The Arts (HL/SL): Film, Music, Theatre, Visual Arts
Core Components: Theory of Knowledge; Extended Essay; Creativity, Activity, and Service (CAS) International Section courses are offered in English (all levels), Biology, US History, and World History.
English-as-an-Additional Language courses, in ascending order, are offered at Levels 1-4

On April 26, 2024, an inspector from the Independent Schools Inspectorate returned to TASIS England following our routine inspection in September. As the report states, the independent school standards are consistently met, and the wellbeing of the pupils is actively promoted.
April 2024 Report from the Independent Schools Inspectorate
In September 2023, ISI inspected TASIS England under the new ISI Framework for inspections. The report highlights many strengths of our School which can be read in the attached report.
September 2023 Report from the Independent Schools Inspectorate
We are delighted that the inspection team recognized that we place student well-being at the center of our decision-making and take great care with our safeguarding measures to promote the safety and well-being of our students. Among the many highlights of the report, we are especially pleased to see the acknowledgment of:
In addition to the highlights, we are grateful for the two recommendations that will support our continued growth and development.
In May 2019, ISI visited TASIS England to carry out a Regulatory Compliance Inspection. The report confirms that our School is fully compliant in all respects with the rigorous regulations and standards set by the Department for Education.
May 2019 Report from the Independent Schools Inspectorate
During their visit, the inspectors had discussions with members of our faculty, staff, Board, and parent community. They spoke to students and examined samples of their work as they observed lessons, an assembly, and extracurricular activities. They also visited our facilities, from the boarding houses to the Lower School, as well as the learning support and education resource areas.
The responses to the surveys submitted by TASIS parents, faculty, and staff provided a valuable source of information for the inspection team and we are grateful to everyone who took the time to complete these questionnaires. Despite the very short time-frame allowed, over 420 parents responded – a very clear demonstration of the partnership between our families and our School. Furthermore, it was very heartening to see the high levels of positive feedback. Throughout the survey, 91% or more of the responses to each area were positive. We appreciate this show of support and the recognition of the incredible amount of time, energy, and commitment that our faculty and staff invest in our programs and, most importantly, in our students.
The report details the eight key areas which were the focus of this inspection. The ISI Regulatory Compliance Inspection Report relates to regulatory requirements. The findings are communicated in a “pass/fail” or "met/not met" fashion, rather than as a qualitative ranking. While we are very pleased that the inspectors concluded that all standards are being met, we are even prouder to note that the report contains no recommendations for improvement. There is no further action which the School must take except to ensure that we continue to maintain the Independent School Standards.

pageCache.pageTitle: The TASIS Schools - TASIS The American School in England, London, UK. IB School
pageCache.text:
TASIS is a family of international schools that welcomes young people from all nationalities to an educational community which fosters a passion for excellence along with mutual respect and understanding. Consistent with the vision of its founder, M. Crist Fleming, TASIS is committed to transmitting the heritage of Western Civilization and world cultures: the creations, achievements, traditions, and ideals from the past that offer purpose in the present and hope for the future. Seeking to balance the pursuit of knowledge with the love of wisdom, and promoting the skills of lifelong learning, an appreciation for beauty, and the development of character, each school combines a challenging academic program with opportunities for artistic endeavor, physical activity, and service to others. Believing in the worth of each individual and the importance of enduring relationships, TASIS seeks to embody and instill the values of personal responsibility, civility, compassion, justice, and truth.
The TASIS Schools and Summer Programs are owned by the TASIS Foundation, a Swiss not-for-profit educational foundation registered in Delémont, Switzerland.

pageCache.pageTitle: Your Child’s Journey in Upper School | TASIS England
pageCache.text:
TASIS England Upper School: a special place of life and learning
TASIS England Upper School students are enthusiastic in their pursuit of knowledge. Students immerse themselves in a broad and demanding program of study that incorporates a rigorous “regular” level curriculum, including over 20 Advanced Placement courses, the opportunity to earn an International Baccalaureate Diploma, and an extensive English-as-an-Additional Language program.
What does TASIS England offer in Upper School?
Life and adventures await. We prepare our students for the challenges and opportunities of the future by recognizing each individual's unique strengths, interests, and skills. Our experienced faculty delivers the combination of challenge and support your child needs to reach their full potential. We’re passionate about providing a personalized learning journey for each learner. To discover the advantages of studying in the IB Diploma Programme and taking Advanced Placement (AP) courses, take a look at the infographic below:
While instilling a sense of wonder and intellectual curiosity, an Upper School education extends way beyond the classroom. TASIS England offers personalization and learning extension through clubs, activities, interest groups, and sporting events. Our diverse and dynamic visual and performing arts department fosters an appreciation for the arts, and students are encouraged to stay physically fit through participation in recreational and team sports or fitness options.
Our wide range of co-curricular and community service activities promote valuable life skills such as leadership, sportsmanship, and collaboration. Passions can be sparked and abilities are developed as students grow in confidence and maturity. We encourage students to find their voice, discover something they love doing, and unlock a life-long thirst for learning.
Hear From Our Students
Our four-year College Counseling curriculum provides a tailored approach and our college counselors guide students every step of the way as they set their personal goals and research the post-secondary options that are best for them. The counselors help students manage the application process and serve as a liaison between the students and universities. Many TASIS England students go on to study at world-class colleges and universities across the globe.
Find Out More About College Counseling
TASIS England offers the option of a residential program in which students (aged 13 to 18) from around the world flourish in the safe and supportive environment of the boarding houses. They have the time of their lives while developing the vital life attributes of independence, responsibility, and resilience. Students build long-lasting friendships as they live and learn together, and enjoy a broad range of exciting weekend activities.
Learn More About Boarding
Moving your family across the country or the world can be a daunting experience. When your child joins TASIS England, your whole family becomes part of a welcoming and diverse community that will support you through your transition. We will help you settle in and find your feet with practical assistance and social events designed to soften your landing.
